model_name: CropSentinel Agronomic Suitability, Stress & Visual Leaf-Health Model

dataset_metadata.details: Expanded national starter reference catalogue for CropSentinel.
182 distinct crop entries, including additional fruits, vegetables, leafy greens, root/tuber crops and mushrooms.
This is not literally every crop grown in India and not a validated diagnosis dataset. Values vary by cultivar, state, season, growth stage, soil type and management.
Indicative screening ranges, not universal stress thresholds. Some crops have special requirements such as winter chilling or stage-specific limits.
Broad environmental suitability ranges, not irrigation prescriptions. Use effective rainfall, soil water balance and crop duration for operational recommendations.
A single ideal relative-humidity range is not appropriate for all crops/stages; leaf wetness and disease risk may matter more.
Do not use one percentage for every crop. Calibrate sensor readings and set thresholds by crop, soil texture and growth stage.
Mushrooms are not field crops in the same sense; soil pH and annual rainfall may not apply. Use substrate and controlled-environment parameters.
Store crop profile separately from observation records. Record crop, variety, location, sowing date, growth stage, sensor readings, source, timestamp and alert reason.

profiles.soil_texture_and_drainage: Clay loam to loam; paddy tolerates puddled soils
profiles.stress_watchouts: High water demand; flowering heat and water deficit are critical
profiles.humidity_guidance: No universal ideal RH value; use crop, growth stage, canopy wetness and local disease guidance
profiles.soil_moisture_threshold: Not universal; define by crop stage, soil texture, sensor calibration and local irrigation guidance
profiles.confidence_note: Broad screening range only; verify cultivar, region, growth stage and local extension guidance before automated diagnosis
profiles.visual_ideal_leaf_colour_by_stage: Emergence/seedling: green first leaves; tillering/branching: green, actively growing foliage; stem elongation/flowering/grain or pod filling: crop-typical green foliage; maturity: natural yellowing/drying is expected. Confirm cultivar and local guide.
profiles.current_photo_colour_comparison: Compare the uploaded photo only with a reference for the SAME crop, cultivar if known, growth stage, lighting and camera conditions. Assess representative leaves (not soil/background); check whether colour is uniformly typical or shows chlorosis/yellowing, browning, mottling, spots, edge burn or unusual purple/red tones. Image colour alone cannot diagnose cause.
profiles.healthy_rate_percent_method: Suggested prototype score (0–100, not a validated agronomic diagnosis): 40% visual leaf-colour/colour-uniformity match; 25% visible symptom severity; 20% crop-condition fit (temperature, pH, moisture/rainfall where available); 15% growth-stage fit. Calculate each component as 0–100, then weighted sum. If a component is unavailable, renormalize available weights and show confidence.
profiles.visual_health_scoring_weights: Colour match 40%; symptom severity 25%; environmental-condition fit 20%; growth-stage fit 15%. Show confidence separately.
profiles.image_comparison_safety_note: Use as decision support only. Leaf colour varies with variety, age, nutrient status, disease, water stress, shadows, white balance and phone camera. Do not label a crop healthy/unhealthy from colour alone; request clear daylight photos of several leaves and combine with field observations.

profiles.visual_ideal_leaf_colour_by_stage: Seedling/early vegetative: generally fresh green leaves; vegetative: crop-typical green foliage; flowering/fruiting: healthy green foliage with normal crop-specific flowers/fruits; maturity/senescence: gradual natural yellowing may occur. Confirm cultivar and local guide.
profiles.current_photo_colour_comparison: Compare the uploaded photo only with a reference for the SAME crop, cultivar if known, growth stage, lighting and camera conditions. Assess representative leaves (not soil/background); check whether colour is uniformly typical or shows chlorosis/yellowing, browning, mottling, spots, edge burn or unusual purple/red tones. Image colour alone cannot diagnose cause.
profiles.healthy_rate_percent_method: Suggested prototype score (0–100, not a validated agronomic diagnosis): 40% visual leaf-colour/colour-uniformity match; 25% visible symptom severity; 20% crop-condition fit (temperature, pH, moisture/rainfall where available); 15% growth-stage fit. Calculate each component as 0–100, then weighted sum. If a component is unavailable, renormalize available weights and show confidence.
profiles.visual_health_scoring_weights: Colour match 40%; symptom severity 25%; environmental-condition fit 20%; growth-stage fit 15%. Show confidence separately.
profiles.image_comparison_safety_note: Use as decision support only. Leaf colour varies with variety, age, nutrient status, disease, water stress, shadows, white balance and phone camera. Do not label a crop healthy/unhealthy from colour alone; request clear daylight photos of several leaves and combine with field observations.

profiles.confidence_note: Broad screening range only; verify cultivar, region, growth stage and local extension guidance before automated diagnosis
profiles.visual_ideal_leaf_colour_by_stage: Seedling/early vegetative: generally fresh green leaves; vegetative: crop-typical green foliage; flowering/fruiting: healthy green foliage with normal crop-specific flowers/fruits; maturity/senescence: gradual natural yellowing may occur. Confirm cultivar and local guide.
profiles.current_photo_colour_comparison: Compare the uploaded photo only with a reference for the SAME crop, cultivar if known, growth stage, lighting and camera conditions. Assess representative leaves (not soil/background); check whether colour is uniformly typical or shows chlorosis/yellowing, browning, mottling, spots, edge burn or unusual purple/red tones. Image colour alone cannot diagnose cause.
profiles.healthy_rate_percent_method: Suggested prototype score (0–100, not a validated agronomic diagnosis): 40% visual leaf-colour/colour-uniformity match; 25% visible symptom severity; 20% crop-condition fit (temperature, pH, moisture/rainfall where available); 15% growth-stage fit. Calculate each component as 0–100, then weighted sum. If a component is unavailable, renormalize available weights and show confidence.
profiles.visual_health_scoring_weights: Colour match 40%; symptom severity 25%; environmental-condition fit 20%; growth-stage fit 15%. Show confidence separately.
profiles.image_comparison_safety_note: Use as decision support only. Leaf colour varies with variety, age, nutrient status, disease, water stress, shadows, white balance and phone camera. Do not label a crop healthy/unhealthy from colour alone; request clear daylight photos of several leaves and combine with field observations.
